SELECT c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND l.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  );

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan not paid (debt)'
        WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Contract running, payments OK'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Contract running, in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    MAX(
        l.amount - (l.payments * MIN(
            (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12
            + (CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)),
            l.duration
        )),
        0
    ) AS remaining_debt
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_seg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM base
  GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT b.Segment, b.Consumption
  FROM base b
  JOIN min_seg m ON b.Segment = m.Segment AND b.Consumption = m.min_consumption
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
  FROM lowest
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
    - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM CustomerTotals ct
    JOIN MinTotals m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;

                           WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK' AND T4.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T1.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK' AND T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)) AS d1,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'

                           FROM yearmonth AS T3
                           JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T4.Currency = 'CZK' AND T4.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'KAM'

  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'SME'

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT l.Segment,
           l.CustomerID,
           l.total_consumption
    FROM czk2013 AS l
    WHERE l.total_consumption = (
        SELECT MIN(z.total_consumption)
        FROM czk2013 AS z
        WHERE z.Segment = l.Segment
    )
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

    / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account a

WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID, c.Segment
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND t.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, z.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN czk_customers z ON y.CustomerID = z.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, z.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT s.Segment, SUM(s.total_consumption) AS sum_total, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM segment_consumption s
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY s.Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_total * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_annual AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment,
           SUM(ca.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_annual ca
    JOIN min_cons mc
      ON ca.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND ca.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T2."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T2 WHERE T2.ID IN (SELECT T1.ID FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.GOT >= 60)

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5) AND ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS average_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);

SELECT T3.element, T4.element
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T2.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T1.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id 
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' 
  AND ((T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c') 
    OR (T2.element = 'c' AND T3.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_type = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom.molecule_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    fr.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / NULLIF(fr.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS fr
JOIN schools AS sc
    ON fr.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(t.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 9;

SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm T1
      INNER JOIN schools T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
      WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) = 1980;

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    satscores.sname AS School_Name,
    schools.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson'
       AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez'
       AND AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(T2.School) AS total_schools
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' 
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT 
    County,
    COUNT(CDSCode) AS Number_of_Closures
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = '11'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY Number_of_Closures DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School AS `School Name`,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    f.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'

SELECT 
    F.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / F.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,

SELECT DISTINCT
    s.AdmEmail1, 
    s.AdmEmail2, 
    s.AdmEmail3
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

    s.County = 'San Bernardino'

SELECT p.Title

WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM badges 
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS NumComments
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT users.DisplayName AS Editor
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName

JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE Location = 'New York'
  AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teachers')
  AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.UserId
FROM postHistory AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY T1.UserId, T1.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

SELECT u.Id AS UserId,
       u.DisplayName,
       b.Name AS Badge
FROM users u
JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
) c ON c.UserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.CommentCount = (
    SELECT MAX(CommentCount)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
        FROM comments
        GROUP BY UserId
    ) t
);

SELECT 
    ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) AS unique_commenters

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption of every CZK-paying customer, with their segment
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS yearly_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Keep only the customer(s) with the lowest 2013 consumption in each segment,
    -- then total their consumption and count them
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.yearly_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(z.CustomerID)       AS n_customers
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, MIN(yearly_consumption) AS min_consumption
        FROM czk_2013
        GROUP BY Segment
    ) AS m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption per year / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT Segment,
           CAST(total_consumption AS REAL) / n_customers AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_per_segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH loan_months AS (
    SELECT
        l.*,
        -- Months elapsed since the loan was issued (SQLite-compatible)
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER)) * 12
        + (CAST(strftime('%m', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date) AS INTEGER)) AS months_elapsed
    FROM loan l
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    m.loan_id,
    m.amount                                              AS loan_amount,
    m.payments                                            AS monthly_payment,
    m.duration                                            AS loan_duration_months,
    m.date                                                AS loan_issue_date,
    m.months_elapsed                                      AS months_since_issue,
    MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration)                     AS payments_made,
    MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration) * m.payments        AS total_paid_so_far,
    -- Estimated remaining debt
    m.amount - MIN(m.months_elapsed, m.duration) * m.payments AS remaining_debt,
    -- Payment performance based on the loan status code
    CASE m.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client in debt'
    END                                                   AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d       ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan_months m ON m.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS percentage_female_marvel
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2
  ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        THEN 'More in-patients' 
        ELSE 'More outpatients' 
    END AS comparison,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
    2) AS percentage_deviation
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Date, 
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' 
    AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count,
       ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS days_difference
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    Laboratory.ID,
    Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation_of_TP_from_normal
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' 
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Not within normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE T.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T2
        WHERE T2.ID = T.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F')) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT 
    L.ID,
    L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY 
    L."T-CHO" DESC,   -- highest total cholesterol first
    P.Birthday ASC    -- among ties, pick the earliest birthday (oldest)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
INNER JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ana_level
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '-' AND T1.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON atom.molecule_id      = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id     = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id          = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element AS element1, T3.element AS element2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    bond.bond_type, 
    connected.atom_id, 
    connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected AS c2
        JOIN atom AS a1 ON c2.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ) AS t
);

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(element) = 2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND T2.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule 
    ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE m.label 
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenicity
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customer(s)
    --                 / number of customers at that lowest level
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM annual_avg;

WITH italy_matches AS (
    SELECT M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_player_ids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT account_id 
        FROM loan
  );

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp     ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest female client(s): earliest birth date (smaller birth_date = older)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- among those oldest females, keep only the district with the lowest average salary
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (
              SELECT district_id
              FROM client
              WHERE gender = 'F'
                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                  FROM client
                                  WHERE gender = 'F')
        )
      );

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.date            AS loan_date,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in DEBT'
    END AS payment_status

SELECT m.position

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name

SELECT event_name

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

FROM expense ex

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name

WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT

    major.department
FROM member

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college

SELECT

    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent

SELECT z.city

SELECT T1.full_name

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes

SELECT
    -- Percentage of superheroes whose alignment is 'Bad'
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(s.id),
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,

             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s

WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name

SELECT s.superhero_name

  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT sp.power_name

SELECT s.full_name

WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(CASE WHEN skin_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)

FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT

    sp.power_name

JOIN alignment a

JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp

WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero

JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id

WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id

FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count

JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
