SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Brown'
  AND s.weight_kg < 100;

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS inpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT L.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(L.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS Original_Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_first_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.ALP,
       CASE
           WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
                  THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 / 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 
                  THEN Patient.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
  AND T2.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b       ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1      ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2      ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE pb.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE pb.element = 'pb';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS carcinogenic_percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 'cl' END) = 1
          AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'c'  THEN 'c'  END) = 1
         THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS answer
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a 
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE m.label
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic_label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'c';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_with_triple_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T2.District
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.School, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.School, T1.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.`School`, s.`Street`, s.`City`, s.`State`, s.`Zip`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm f2
    WHERE f2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
);

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'San Joaquin'
  AND Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.School)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '9'

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT City, GSserved, School
FROM schools
WHERE State = 'CA'
ORDER BY Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, frpm.`District Code`
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54;
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users);

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount)
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND u.Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teacher')
  AND u.Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
  AND u.Id IN (
      SELECT ph.UserId
      FROM postHistory ph
      GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
      HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = 1
  );

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    ORDER BY CommentCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON b.UserId = t.UserId;

SELECT ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId)
        FROM comments c
        WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommentUsers
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
INNER JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(T1.UpVotes) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS AvgUpVotes,
       SUM(T1.Age) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS AvgAge
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1.Id IN (
    SELECT T2.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts AS T2
    GROUP BY T2.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(T2.OwnerUserId) > 10
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer';

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Name = 'Teacher' THEN UserId END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(UserId) AS Percentage
FROM badges;
SELECT T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0'

SELECT DISTINCT users.Age
FROM users
JOIN badges ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010';

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010') * 1.0 
     / (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011') AS ratio;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Tags
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR users.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder'
GROUP BY users.DisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(posts.ViewCount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId)
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Commentator'
  AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2012-07-21 23:59:59';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT T2.DisplayName, T2.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT p.Title,
       COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount,
       p.LastEditDate
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY p.Title, p.LastEditDate;

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT c.PostId, b.Name
FROM comments c
JOIN badges b ON c.UserId = b.UserId
WHERE c.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', c.CreationDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2013';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000;
SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts ORDER BY FavoriteCount DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Id
FROM users
ORDER BY Age ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens')
  AND strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000 AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) FROM posts);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumComments
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id
                FROM posts
                WHERE Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts));
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > 35000 AND CommentCount = 0;

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(ym.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND ym.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Monthly consumption records of CZK customers in 2013
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value per segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of customers
    -- with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.Consumption) / COUNT(cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON cz.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND cz.Consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger?
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'In-patients'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'Outpatients'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS larger_group,

    -- Raw counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,

    -- Deviation in percentage: (in-patients / outpatients) * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS deviation_percentage,

    -- Percentage point difference relative to outpatients
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS deviation_percent_diff
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, 
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date, 
    (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age_At_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Description,
    P.[First Date],
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS albumin_status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(latest.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, Date, UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
) latest ON p.ID = latest.ID
WHERE latest.rn = 1
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND latest.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND latest.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory  ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' 
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0) 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS YoungestBirthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT l.ID
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY e.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule  ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN A.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(A.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom A
WHERE A.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT B.molecule_id
    FROM bond B
    WHERE B.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') 
    - 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    c.atom_id, 
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top ON m.molecule_id = top.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS bonded_atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT c.atom_id AS bonded_atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(pair_counts.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS pair_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_pct
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES' 
         ELSE 'NO' 
       END AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')
      );

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT
    atom.element,
    COUNT(*) AS element_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'              -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'  -- only the 4th atom of each molecule
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes, carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'No, not carcinogenic'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
INNER JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS number_of_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.School) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' 
    AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
    AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    T2.CharterNum,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS `Rank`
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode, T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.DOC
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)

WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
MinConsumption AS (
    -- The least amount of consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestCustomers AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN MinConsumption mc
        ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
       AND cc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinConsumption
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM LowestCustomers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_vs_SME;
