JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name, MAX(PA.overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY max_overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name, MAX(PA.crossing) AS max_crossing
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match AS M 
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id 
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' 
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.id) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT DISTINCT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM Player
) AS ranked_players
WHERE height_rank = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.player_name,
    C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
        M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
        M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
        M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country AS C
    ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country AS C
JOIN Match AS M ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(p.height)
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1
WHERE c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage_of_players
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
  );

SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
       AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE 
           WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
           WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'
           ELSE 'Equal'
       END AS higher_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c 
    ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')   -- oldest female(s): earliest birth_date
ORDER BY d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;                                    -- among them, the one with lowest average salary

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '93%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE duration > 12
  );

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT DISTINCT
       acc.account_id,
       acc.frequency
FROM account acc
JOIN disp     d   ON d.account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN client   cl  ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dis ON dis.district_id = cl.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'                        -- account holder (owner) of the account
  AND dis.A3 = 'east Bohemia'                 -- A3 = region name (east Bohemia)
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', acc.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    district_id AS branch_location,
    A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' 
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(type) = 'gold' 
              AND CAST(strftime('%Y', issued) AS INTEGER) < 1998 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(client.client_id) AS percentage_of_women
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   -
   SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      )
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) 
     FROM district 
     WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) 
     FROM district 
     WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d 
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount      AS loan_amount,
    l.payments    AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D');

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_account_count
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e 
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT E.event_name
FROM event AS E
INNER JOIN attendance AS A ON E.event_id = A.link_to_event
GROUP BY E.event_id, E.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(A.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) 
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE T3.first_name = 'Sacha' 
  AND T3.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id)
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
GROUP BY T1.event_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_member) > 10;

SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 
    ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY T1.event_name
HAVING COUNT(T1.event_id) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(e.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
  AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member AS m
JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(budget.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' 
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT M.first_name, M.last_name
FROM member AS M
JOIN income AS I ON M.member_id = I.link_to_member
WHERE I.source = 'Dues'
  AND I.date_received = (
      SELECT MIN(date_received)
      FROM income
      WHERE source = 'Dues'
  );

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Parking' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / SUM(amount) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_from_maryland
FROM member
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE zip_code.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Meeting' 
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense ex ON m.member_id = ex.link_to_member
JOIN budget b   ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.category, 
       SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id, category, amount
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Phillip' 
  AND member.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';
SELECT type FROM event WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00';

SELECT m.major_name
FROM major AS m
JOIN member AS mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
WHERE mem.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed' 
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN expense AS e
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT M.email
FROM member M
JOIN expense E ON M.member_id = E.link_to_member
WHERE E.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND E.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(ex.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense ex
JOIN member m ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY MAX(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 
    ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT 
    major.major_name,
    major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p 
    ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM superhero 
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT id 
    FROM publisher 
    WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
);

SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(s.id) AS bad_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_comics_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT s.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower s ON hp.power_id = s.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percent
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT full_name
FROM superhero
WHERE weight_kg = 0
   OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT 
    a.alignment,
    sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a 
    ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp 
    ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp 
    ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' 
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100
  AND T2.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
    / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA = '8.4'
  AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_elapsed
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    l.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.TP,
    l.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T3
        WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(T1.SEX = 'M') > SUM(T1.SEX = 'F') 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT
    L.ID       AS patient_id,
    L."T-CHO"  AS t_cho
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory  AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.SYMPTOMS IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS Percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS First_Recorded_Date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination AS T3
      INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.atom_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T2.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'        -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'    -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT B.bond_type, C.atom_id, C.atom_id2
FROM bond AS B
JOIN connected AS C ON B.bond_id = C.bond_id
WHERE B.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
         / COUNT(b.bond_id),
         5
       ) AS pct_carcinogenic_single_bonds
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS total
FROM atom
JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Consumption records of CZK customers in 2013 (first 4 chars of Date = year)
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
),
lowest AS (
    -- Lowest consumption per segment for 2013
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_consumption AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption at the lowest level / number of customers at that level
    SELECT k.Segment,
           SUM(k.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(k.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 k
    JOIN lowest l
      ON k.Segment = l.Segment
     AND k.Consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY k.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    total_loan_amount,
    monthly_payment,
    duration,
    status,
    CASE
        WHEN total_loan_amount - monthly_payment * months_elapsed > 0
            THEN total_loan_amount - monthly_payment * months_elapsed
        ELSE 0
    END AS outstanding_debt
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount        AS total_loan_amount,
        l.payments      AS monthly_payment,
        l.duration,
        l.status,
        -- months elapsed since loan was taken (SQLite-compatible)
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date)   AS INTEGER)) * 12
        + (CAST(strftime('%m', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%m', l.date)   AS INTEGER)) AS months_elapsed
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d   ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id = 992
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to CZK customers
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    -- The lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption
    -- customer(s) / number of those customers, per segment
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Abnormal'
    END AS ALP_Status
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'

ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T2.UA) AS Average_UA_Index
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2

WHERE T2.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(Date)
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE ID = T1.ID

  AND (
        (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5)

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

SELECT

    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

        SELECT molecule_id

SELECT molecule.label

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id

FROM molecule m

WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS atom_count
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id

);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_cust AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(DISTINCT z.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON m.Segment = z.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = z.Consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_cust
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(T3.amount)
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id
INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;
SELECT account.account_id, account.date FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id 
    FROM district 
    ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS REAL) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
  AND loan.amount >= 250000 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
  AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND client.gender = 'M';
